```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  dev.args = list(bg = "white"),
  collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", out.width = "100%",
  dpi = 150, fig.width = 7
)
```

Every map tidymapr draws. Each entry has three tabs: the map, the tidy
table behind it, and the code. Maps use the colour-blind-safe Okabe-Ito
palette and `theme_tidymapr()`, which matches
`tidydiversity::theme_tidydiversity()`. Every map uses real, published
records: `geo_example_sites()` returns the bait GPS of the Mt Wilhelm ant
survey (`png_ants_sites`; Mottl, Moses and Klimes 2023,
[doi:10.5281/zenodo.8191946](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8191946)).

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(tidymapr)
library(tidydiversity)
library(ggplot2)
set.seed(1)
sites <- geo_example_sites("wilhelm")
```

## Study-site map {.tabset}

### Map

```{r sites, echo = FALSE, fig.height = 5, fig.alt = "Study sites along Mt Wilhelm coloured by elevation band, with labels, scale bar and north arrow"}
plot_sites(sites, lon, lat, colour = elevation_band, label = site, basemap = "coast")
```

### Table

```{r sites-table}
sites
```

### Code

```r
sites <- geo_example_sites("wilhelm")
plot_sites(sites, lon, lat, colour = elevation_band, label = site, basemap = "coast")
```

## Hill numbers on a map {.tabset}

```{r hill-data, include = FALSE}
est <- div_estimate(png_ants, q = 0, nboot = 0, .by = season)
est <- dplyr::left_join(est, sites[c("site", "lon", "lat")], by = "site")
est_dry <- est[est$season == "dry", ]
```

### Map

```{r hill-map, echo = FALSE, fig.height = 5, fig.alt = "Observed ant richness at each Mt Wilhelm site in the dry season"}
plot_geo(est_dry, estimate, lon, lat, label = site, basemap = "coast")
```

### Table

```{r hill-table}
est_dry
```

### Code

```r
est <- div_estimate(png_ants, q = 0, nboot = 0, .by = season)
est <- dplyr::left_join(est, sites[c("site", "lon", "lat")], by = "site")
plot_geo(est[est$season == "dry", ], estimate, lon, lat, label = site, basemap = "coast")
```

## Distance decay {.tabset}

```{r decay-data, include = FALSE}
com <- dplyr::left_join(png_ants, sites[c("site", "lon", "lat")], by = "site")
decay <- geo_decay(com, lon, lat, .by = season, method = "haversine")
```

### Plot

```{r decay, echo = FALSE, fig.height = 4, fig.alt = "Pairwise ant dissimilarity against great-circle distance by season"}
autoplot(decay)
```

### Table

```{r decay-table}
decay
```

### Code

```r
com <- dplyr::left_join(png_ants, sites[c("site", "lon", "lat")], by = "site")
decay <- geo_decay(com, lon, lat, .by = season, method = "haversine")
autoplot(decay)
```

## Sites over SRTM elevation {.tabset}

### Plot

<img src="../reference/figures/gallery-map-elevation.png" alt="Mt Wilhelm ant bait sites over SRTM elevation" style="width: 100%;">

### Table

Both transects of every elevation band, with the mean GPS elevation of
their baits:

```{r map-elev-table}
png_ants_sites
```

### Code

```r
# SRTM 3 arc-second tiles either side of 145 E, cached at run time
srtm <- file.path(tools::R_user_dir("tidymapr", "cache"), "elevation")
dem <- terra::merge(
  geodata::elevation_3s(lon = 144.9, lat = -5.8, path = srtm),
  geodata::elevation_3s(lon = 145.2, lat = -5.8, path = srtm)
)
dem <- terra::crop(dem, terra::ext(144.85, 145.5, -5.98, -5.55))
names(dem) <- "Elevation (m)"
plot_sites(
  sites, lon, lat,
  label = site, raster = dem, basemap = "none",
  inset = "png", legend_position = "outside"
)
```

## Species distribution model (GBIF and WorldClim) {.tabset}

Habitat suitability of the green tree ant *Oecophylla smaragdina* across
Papua New Guinea. Presences are GBIF records released under CC0 or
CC BY 4.0 (GBIF.org occurrence search, 6 November 2026; dataset keys in
the table), and the predictors are WorldClim 2.1 mean annual temperature
(bio1) and annual rainfall (bio12) at 5 arc-minutes (Fick and Hijmans
2017, [doi:10.1002/joc.5086](https://doi.org/10.1002/joc.5086)). The
model is the native Maxent-like engine of `sdm_fit()` with 2000
background points; its modest AUC (0.63) is shown on the map.

### Plot

<img src="../reference/figures/gallery-map-sdm.png" alt="Habitat suitability map of Oecophylla smaragdina in Papua New Guinea with GBIF occurrence points" style="width: 100%;">

### Table

```{r map-sdm-table}
occ <- read.csv(
  system.file("extdata", "gbif_oecophylla_png.csv", package = "tidymapr"),
  colClasses = c(gbif_id = "character")
)
tibble::as_tibble(occ)
```

### Code

```r
occ <- read.csv(
  system.file("extdata", "gbif_oecophylla_png.csv", package = "tidymapr")
)
clim <- geo_worldclim(c("bio1", "bio12"), res = 5)
clim <- terra::crop(clim, terra::ext(140.8, 156.1, -11.7, -0.8))
png0 <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(
  country = "Papua New Guinea", scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf"
)
clim <- terra::mask(clim, terra::vect(png0))
fit <- sdm_fit(occ, predictors = clim, engine = "maxnet",
               n_background = 2000, seed = 1)
sdm_evaluate(fit)

grid <- terra::as.data.frame(clim, xy = TRUE, cells = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
names(grid)[2:3] <- c("lon", "lat")
suit <- clim[[1]]
terra::values(suit) <- NA_real_
suit[grid$cell] <- sdm_predict(fit, newdata = grid)$suitability
plot_sdm(suit, basemap = "coast") +
  geom_point(data = occ, aes(lon, lat), shape = 21, fill = "white")
```

A stem map over topography (`plot_topo()`) is not shown: there is no
openly licensed stem inventory to draw it from, and the gallery does not
map invented trees. The figures in these two entries are rendered at
300 dpi by `data-raw/gallery_maps.R`, because the elevation tiles and
climate rasters are downloaded at run time.
